narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I say the diagonal of a rectangle is a line of symmetry, because it cuts two equal triangles.
<bookmark mark='stick'/>Look at the fold. A corner sticks out, and the long side does not meet the short side.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two equal triangles are not enough, because they must also overlap after the fold.
